query: Who was the first US President?
generated_response: The first United States President is George Washington. He took office in 1789 and served for two terms: from 1789 to 1797 and then from 1797 to 1799. Washington was elected by the Continental Congress and was the only man who had never held a prior position in government before assuming the presidency.
